faction.feydom-town.feydom.description:
{Feydom}
Alignment: Evil
Native Terrain: Rough
Homeland: The mysterious continent of the East
The Fey are a mysterious race from the East. Once ordinary beasts and birds, they awakened their minds by drawing in the essence of sun and moon, then set foot upon the path of cultivation. They gather of their own accord, claim mountains as their kingdoms, and compete for cultivation resources under mighty Fey Kings.
faction.feydom-town.feydom.name: Feydom
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero01_feylordBul: Once a great white bull, he cultivated himself into a demon of cunning strategy and boundless strength, honored as the Great Strength King. He now dwells with Princess Jade Face in Thunderhoard Mountain's Cloud-Scraping Cave; his first wife, Princess Iron Fan, bore him a son named Red Boy.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero02_blueLion.b: Once the mount of Manjushri, the Azure Lion could swallow a hundred thousand heavenly soldiers in one gulp. After descending to the mortal world, he occupied Lion-Camel Ridge and became sworn brother to Six-Tusked Elephant and Golden-Winged Roc.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero02_blueLion.s: Feasters and Taotie gain +1 speed; for every hero level, they also gain +1 hit point.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero03_whiteEleph: Once the mount of Samantabhadra, he descended to the mortal world and occupied Lion-Camel Ridge, becoming sworn brother to Azure Lion King and Golden-Winged Roc.
Casts Stone Skin with increased effect.
A scion of the phoenix line. His elder sister, Peacock, is revered as the Mother of Buddhas, while Golden-Winged Roc wandered into the mortal realm and seized the Lion-Camel Kingdom. He later went to Lion-Camel Ridge and swore brotherhood with Azure Lion King and Six-Tusked Elephant.
Receives a 5% per level bonus to Logistics skill percentage.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero05_greatApe.b: An elder monkey sage of Flower-Fruit Mountain, said to grasp sun and moon, shrink mountains, read fortune and disaster, and toy with heaven and earth. He often counseled the Monkey King, urging him to seek a master and divine weapon, earning his deep trust. When his life neared its end, the Monkey King stormed the underworld and erased his name from the ledgers of death.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero05_greatApe.s: Snow Apes and Wasp-Tamer Apes gain +1 speed and +3 damage.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero06_blueBull.b: Once the mount of the Grand Supreme Elderly Lord, he saw the cowherd boy fall asleep after eating an immortal pill, then carried the household treasures down to the mortal world and proclaimed himself the Single-Horned Rhinoceros King.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero06_blueBull.s: Casts Frost Ring with increased effect.
A bear spirit cultivated in Black Wind Mountain's Black Wind Cave, also known as the Black Bear Monster and Black Wind Monster. He was close to Elder Jinchi of Guanyin Monastery and often discussed doctrine and meditation.
Provides your kingdom with 350 additional gold each day.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero08_sixears.bi: One of the Four Monkeys of Havoc, his powers rival Sun Wukong's. He hears all sounds, discerns all principles, knows past and future, and understands all things. He also commands the same seventy-two transformations and cloud-somersault arts, and wields an iron staff no less wondrous than the golden cudgel.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero08_sixears.sp: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Learning skill percentage.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero09_gold.biogr: Originally a disciple of the Grand Supreme Elderly Lord, charged with guarding the Alchemy Furnace. Only after Guanyin asked three times was he permitted to descend as a demon, to test Tang Sanzang's resolve and confiscate his traveling treasures.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero09_gold.name: Gold Horn King
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero09_gold.speci: Reduces enemy morale by 1 in combat.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero10_silver.bio: Once the Silver Spirit Boy under the Grand Supreme Elderly Lord, he descended to the mortal world as Silver Horn King and occupied Lotus Cave together with Gold Horn King.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero10_silver.spe: Reduces enemy luck by 1 in combat.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero11_yellowMous: A marten from beneath Spirit Mountain, he stole lamp oil and left the Buddha hall dim and dark. Fearing capture by the guardian vajras, he fled in guilt to the mortal realm and claimed a mountain as king.
Casts Disrupting Ray with increased effect.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero12_leopard.bi: A former disciple of the Primordial Lord of Heaven who later betrayed the Chan sect. Sly and persuasive, he lured Jie sect peers into helping Zhou fight the Shang. For breaking his oath he was cast into the North Sea Eye, and was finally enfeoffed as the Water-Dividing General of the East Sea.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero12_leopard.sp: Casts Lightning Bolt with increased effect.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero51_yellowBrow: Once the chime-bearing boy beneath Buddha Maitreya, he stole his master's treasures and slipped down to the mortal realm. There he built Little Thunderclap Monastery in imitation of the Great Thunderclap Monastery and dwelt within, masquerading as the Tathagata.
Based on hero level, the army's base Attack is increased by +1% per level; Attack granted by artifacts is increased by an additional +1% per level.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero52_redKid.bio: Son of the Bull Demon King and Princess Iron Fan, titled the Holy Infant King. Though childlike in appearance, his cultivation is profound; he wields Samadhi Fire and fought the Monkey King many times without defeat.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero53_rakshasi.b: Wife of the Bull Demon King, dwelling in Plantain Cave on Emerald Cloud Mountain, and mother to Red Boy. She once clashed with the Monkey King, but repented before great wrong was done; later she lived under an assumed name, pursued cultivation, and attained the true fruit.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero54_ladyFox.bi: The favored consort of King Zhou of Shang. With nation-toppling beauty and talent, she won the king's exclusive favor, and was sent by Nüwa to bring ruin upon the Shang dynasty.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero55_ladyWhiteB: Once mere bones in the wild hills, she drew in the qi of heaven and earth and the essence of sun and moon until spirit awakened within her, allowing her to take human form.
Increases this hero's map speed used for movement calculation by +5.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero56_ladySpider: One of the demonesses of Webbed Cave. Originally a spider in the cave, she cultivated the Way, took human form, and can spray silk from her navel.
Reduces the speed of all enemy troops by 1 in combat.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero57_ladyEarthF: Originally a golden-nosed white mouse on Spirit Mountain, she stole fragrant candles and was captured by Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King Li and Nezha. The Tathagata spared her life out of mercy and released her back to the wilds.
Receives a 5% per level bonus to Offense skill percentage.
hero.feydom-town.feydomHero58_jadeRabbit: The Jade Rabbit who pounded medicine in the Moon Palace of Guanghan. After Fairy Su'e slapped her, she nursed a grudge. When Su'e reincarnated as the princess of Tianzhu, the rabbit descended as a demon and waited for revenge.
Receives a 5% per level bonus to First Aid skill percentage.
